name: 9,10-Diphenylanthracene (DPA)
description: Benchmark annihilator. Abs ~375 / Em ~410-430 nm, QY ~0.95.

name: Pyrene
description: UV annihilator; famous for excimer emission (~480 nm).

name: Rubrene
description: Tetraphenyltetracene. Yellow annihilator (Em ~560 nm); also a singlet-fission material.

name: PtOEP (sensitizer)
description: Pt(II) octaethylporphyrin. Absorbs ~535 nm, phosphoresces ~646 nm; pairs with DPA.
